messages:
Nadia: Heads-up — Verdant Labs wants traffic pinned to ca-central-1 for a Canada pilot. They asked for a short ‘peak’ throughput bump during a customer webinar and IP allowlisting for their proxy. Renewal flagged as at-risk; they want a cost vs. performance runbook before the renewal meeting.
leo_net: Got it. Can you get their source CIDRs, ASN and ops contact? Need LOA for proxy peering + signed demo window to schedule ACL changes.
Nadia: Sent prelim: src CIDRs 172.58.200.0/27 and 198.51.100.96/28, NAT IP 203.0.113.90. Ops contact netops@verdantlabs.ai. Webinar window: 2026-10-04T16:00Z -> 2026-10-04T20:00Z. They want a 6-hour peak capacity bump.
Tomas_se: Current plan is 75 req/min. For a webinar spike I recommend a temporary 600 req/min per route and dedicating a route to keep KV/prefix affinity. Also propose a short token budget cap to avoid runaway costs during the webinar.
Mei_csm: I'll handle renewal cadence and the cost runbook. Can we include an estimated token-cost delta for the 6-hour bump and a p50/p95 latency estimate for ca-central-1? I'll add a short ROI slide.
Arjun_ops: Ephemeral allowlist OK. Propose TTL=5 days and auto-revoke at 2026-10-09T08:00Z UTC. We'll send CS a 72h pre-revoke alert. Leo, infra can apply the pin & ACLs once LOA and signed window are attached.
leo_net: Please attach LOA to ticket #CS-77412. I'll queue the pinned route + ACL task after LOA. change_id=chg_vl_20261004_01. Also confirm whether they want proxy peering (yes/no) — Nadia?
Nadia: Confirmed proxy peering. LOA uploaded and customer signed the window.
Tomas_se: Pasting route config (single source of truth):
```
route: /v1/generate/verdant
region_pin: ca-central-1
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 600/min
kv_cache: { warmup_hours: 4 }
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 172.58.200.0/27
  - 198.51.100.96/28
  - 203.0.113.90/32
ephemeral_ttl_days: 5
auto_revoke_at: 2026-10-09T08:00Z
token_budget: 2_000_000
notes: "Webinar peak window 2026-10-04 16:00Z-20:00Z; CS to run cost/throughput runbook + ROI slide. Pre-warm KV 4h before window."
```
infra-bot: network-change: queued change for customer=verdantlabs, change_id=chg_vl_20261004_01, status=queued
Arjun_ops: Approved TTL & auto-revoke. I'll own auto-revoke and the 72h pre-notify. Mei, please attach the cost runbook to the ticket and I'll append the post-demo metrics (p50/p95, error-rate, token usage).
Mei_csm: Will do. I'll also prepare a short feedback survey focusing on latency and perceived correctness. Tagging @Tomas_se for perf numbers.
leo_net: Queued the change. Exec window scheduled 2026-10-04T12:00Z->2026-10-04T14:00Z UTC to pre-warm and deploy. Change id chg_vl_20261004_01.
Nadia: Thanks team :rocket: will update the customer and confirm once infra shows status=scheduled. Mei — I'll cc you on the post-webinar invite for the cost walkthrough.
